steps.name: assert-render-compare-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.renderCompare !== false) throw new Error('renderCompare flag should be OFF in Simple mode but got: ' + window.__store.getState().featureFlags.renderCompare)

steps.name: assert-modal-closed-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().renderCompareOpen) throw new Error('renderCompareOpen should be false in Simple mode')

steps.name: assert-render-compare-enabled-in-pro
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().featureFlags.renderCompare) throw new Error('renderCompare flag should be ON in Pro mode')

steps.name: assert-modal-open-in-store
steps.eval: if (!window.__store.getState().renderCompareOpen) throw new Error('renderCompareOpen should be true after opening')

steps.name: assert-preset-selectors-exist
steps.eval: (() => { const selects = document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay select'); if (selects.length < 1) throw new Error('Expected at least 1 preset selector in render compare modal, found: ' + selects.length); })()

steps.name: assert-render-compare-hidden-again
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.renderCompare !== false) throw new Error('renderCompare should be OFF again in Simple mode')
